result.summary: The page is generally well-designed, but a few visual issues stand out: the pizza card image at the bottom appears oversized/cropped mid-render, a restaurant name is truncated, and some card layout inconsistencies exist.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza image) appears visually broken - the image is oversized, bleeding beyond the card bounds and cut off mid-content at the bottom of the viewport, unlike the properly contained ramen card above it.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image is constrained within the card with proper aspect ratio and object-fit cropping, matching the sizing of the first popular card.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccola' is truncated at the right edge of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Allow text wrapping, reduce font size, or ensure the horizontal scroll carousel fully reveals card content.

issues.description: Category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, etc.) are cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip, which is expected for a scrollable row but the cut-off chip has no visual affordance that scrolling is possible.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade/gradient edge or partial chip visibility hint to indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar is partially cut off by the viewport, showing only the top portion of the icons.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient bottom padding/margin so the navigation bar renders fully within the visible viewport in screenshots/scroll states.
